test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pointing towards a man, Vivek said, "His only brother is the father of my daughter's father". From among the given options, how could the man be related to Vivek?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea38d13398d81798e13b5286a33ca9ad82b6baa1fbaa83ca312796262c786cf5.png] 

Breaking the statement –

His only brother is the father of Vivek's daughter's father so his brother is the father of Vivek.

We can draw the following tree from the information given above:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f17e6495dc30917f2480ee03a86998ccb90667547d4d72b0b9b096a768f69e6.png] 

Hence, the man is **‘Uncle’** of Vivek**.**
